reviewStandard: Only exact reduced L-glutathione is cleared for one immutable heavy-atom connectivity call. Dyshomeostasis, ferritin, ferroportin, hepcidin, and interferon gamma fail physical-subject, species, assembly, ligand, conformation, cellular-context, or assay-state gates and receive no prompt marker or generation call.
promotionRule: Only a literal single-model reduced L-glutathione output matching the frozen twenty-heavy-atom count, tripeptide connectivity boundary, pale field, and crop-safe requirements may proceed to exact-hash review. The other five routes remain non-public scientific holds.

routeDecisions.reason: Ferritin is a cross-species family whose 24-subunit shell composition varies by species and tissue, while the route also combines intracellular protein, mineral loading, bacterial homologs, and serum biomarker interpretation. RCSB 4Y08 is one iron-loaded human H-chain homo-24-mer state.
routeDecisions.requiredResolution: Select exact species, ferritin gene or subunit ratio, assembly, iron-loading state, structure accession, tissue or organism, specimen or assay, units, and claim scope.

routeDecisions.reason: The local route identifies human SLC40A1 but spans several cell types and transport-active, metal-bound, hepcidin-bound, internalized, and degraded states. RCSB 6WBV is one hepcidin- and cobalt-bound nanodisc complex with experimental partners.
routeDecisions.requiredResolution: Select exact sequence and species, membrane compartment and cell type, ligand and metal state, transporter conformation, structure accession, experimental partners to retain or omit, process stage, and claim boundary.
